hero.question: Will Harry Kane win the 2026 Ballon d'Or?
hero.prob_take: At 70.5%, the crowd is pricing Kane as a near-lock to win the Ballon d'Or in 2026, implying he needs only a solid two years at Bayern to overcome Vinicius, Mbappé, and whoever else peaks at the right time. The -6.2 point slide suggests smart money is rotating out, recognizing that Kane's age (34 by award time), injury history, and the Ballon d'Or's recency bias toward peak-year performances make this too short for a player who'll be in the back nine of his career.
